{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
#FLUX: --job-name=petscDMDA
#FLUX: --nodes=1
#FLUX: --ntasks=4
#FLUX: --time=00:10:00
#FLUX: --output=petscDMDA%j.out
#FLUX: --error=petscDMDA%j.out

# The Slurm hint '--hint=nomultithread' has no direct equivalent in Flux and has been omitted.
# This may have performance implications if the system defaults to enabling hyperthreading.

# on se place dans le répertoire de soumission
cd ${FLUX_JOB_WORKDIR}

# nettoyage des modules charges en interactif et herites par defaut
module purge

# chargement des modules
source ../../../petsc.sh

# echo des commandes lancées
set -x

# exécution du code
# The 'srun' command is replaced with 'flux mini run' to ensure proper integration with the Flux scheduler.
time flux mini run -n 4 ./dmda.exe -da_grid_x 1000 -da_grid_y 1000 -ksp_type cg -pc_type hypre
"
}
